## Overview
### Introduction to OpenAI o1
The OpenAI o1 model, released on 2024-12-17, is a premium, non-open-source language model provided by OpenAI. This model boasts a robust architecture that supports a wide range of capabilities, including text generation, function calling, structured outputs, streaming, batch processing, system prompts, and extended thinking. With a context window of 200,000 tokens and a maximum output of 100,000 tokens, OpenAI o1 is designed to handle complex tasks that require in-depth reasoning and analysis.

### Technical Strengths and Use Cases
OpenAI o1 demonstrates exceptional performance across various benchmarks, including MMLU (92.3), HumanEval (94.4), LMSYS Arena ELO (1330), and GSM8K (99.5). These scores underscore the model's strengths in complex reasoning, math, science, coding, and research. As such, OpenAI o1 is best suited for applications that involve PhD-level problems, legal analysis, financial modeling, and other tasks that demand advanced cognitive capabilities. However, it is not recommended for simple tasks, high-volume applications, low-latency requirements, vision tasks, or budget-conscious projects. The pricing structure for OpenAI o1 includes $15.0 per 1M input tokens, $60.0 per 1M output tokens, $7.5 per 1M cached input tokens, and $7.5 per 1M batch input tokens.
